# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the reader's problem and the resulting guidance. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks performed, their results, and any verification gaps.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request targets `dev` and uses a Clean Commit title, or is an authorized `dev` to `main` release pull request.
- [ ] Rule changes begin in `SPECIFICATION.md`; affected summaries and examples agree.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] I checked affected links, anchors, examples, and rendered Markdown.
- [ ] Banner changes use GitHub Repo Banner and preserve its required attribution, if applicable.
